description: This file defines the PermanentRedirectMiddleware class used in AWS SDK for PHP to handle HTTP 301 permanent redirect responses during S3 operations. It implements middleware that checks the response metadata for a 301 status code and throws an exception if encountered.

classes.name: Aws\S3\PermanentRedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that detects 301 redirect responses in AWS S3 SDK operations and throws a PermanentRedirectException.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: A static method that creates a middleware wrapper function which instantiates this class with a given handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a callable next handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, executes the next handler, and checks the result for a 301 status, throwing an exception if detected.
